name: Gelato Jeeter All In One Diamonds Vape | Pocket Ready | 1g | Hybrid
description:
Gelato is a cross between Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC. Since its birth, a number of phenotypes have been released, all with their own unique attributes. One of them is Gelato, a balanced hybrid with compact buds that stay true to its Cookie genetics. Like other Gelato phenotypes, it’s covered in fiery orange hairs, with buds ranging from dark green to deep purple. It delivers sweet citrus and fruity flavors, making it a go-to for unwinding after a long day.

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
